notes.title: 🚂 NULL Train Beta Boarding Now!
notes.content:
[p]🚂 [b]Join the Beta for NULL Train![/b] 🎮[/p][p]We're opening up [b]limited spots[/b] for beta testers—and we want YOU aboard.[/p][p]Whether you're excited to help shape the future of the game, or just love diving into a 2D roguelike with a rich, mysterious storyline, this is your chance to get in early.[/p][p]Hop on, test, and give feedback—or just enjoy the ride.[/p][p]👉 Join our Discord to get started: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/P76v2r7nWZ"]https://discord.gg/P76v2r7nWZ[/url][/p][p]
Seats are limited—don’t miss the train! 🕹️💥[/p]
